description:
Walkability score for a whole US city, precomputed. Instant, no analysis.

Use this for "how walkable is Houston" rather than scoring a point inside it. Returns the 0-100 composite, the same score as 0-10, the tier, and the four components. Covers 203 cities; a city not in the set returns null, which means not covered rather than not walkable.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "Houston", "fort worth", "chicago".

name: get_city_walkability
